subject: Middle School Hat and Hood Policy
overview: Danielle Balocca presented a bonus episode featuring an NPR Student Podcast Challenge finalist podcast created by Andrews Middle School students advocating for changes to the district dress code policy on hats and hoods.

items.title: Podcast Introduction
items.summary: Danielle Balocca introduced the student-produced podcast No Cap, created by Ms. Whalen's eighth-grade class at Andrews Middle School.

items.title: No Cap: Student Proposal on School Hat and Hood Rules
items.summary: Students presented research, teacher interviews, and proposed safety and behavioral compromises to advocate amending the Medford Public Schools dress code policy banning hats and hoods.

items.title: Sign-Off and Contact Information
items.summary: Danielle Balocca concluded the episode and shared podcast contact information for listener feedback.
